_comment: Pro creator approves a TikTok and gets IG Reel + YT Shorts + X thread variants.

source.caption: Three reasons your morning routine is making your sleep worse.

variants.captionRewrite: 3 reasons your morning routine is wrecking your sleep. #2 surprised me.
variants.fallbackPublishInstruction: Open TikTok → tap +, import the prepared clip from your camera roll, paste the caption.

variants.captionRewrite: Your morning routine might be the reason you can't fall asleep. Here's the science — and the 3-step fix.
variants.durationCutSuggestion: Trim to ≤90s. First frame doubles as the cover thumbnail.
variants.fallbackPublishInstruction: Open Instagram → tap +, choose Reel (or Post for carousel), import the prepared media, paste the caption.

variants.captionRewrite: 3 morning habits that ruin your sleep — backed by sleep research.
variants.durationCutSuggestion: If source ≤60s use Shorts vertical. Else re-export 16:9 horizontal as Long.
variants.fallbackPublishInstruction: Open YouTube Studio app → Upload → choose the prepared file, paste title and description.

variants.format: thread of 3-5 tweets with media in first post
variants.captionRewrite: Your morning routine might be wrecking your sleep. Three habits to drop, in a thread.
variants.aspectRatioGuidance: 16:9 horizontal or 1:1 square works on timeline preview
variants.durationCutSuggestion: Trim to ≤2:20 — X autoplay drops off.
variants.fallbackPublishInstruction: Open X → New post, attach media (if any), paste the first tweet, then add the rest of the thread as replies.

output.notes: Post TikTok first (anchor), then X 2h later, then IG Reel + YT Shorts the next day on a ≥12h gap so the cross-post signature doesn't suppress the visually-similar variants.
